title: 第1971章 至尊区第1970章 乾宸宇纪
slug: 吞天混沌经开局先吞圣女修为
content_zh:
“还有等级？”
江尘疑惑道，
“不是中土三州的吧？”
一个声音从身旁传来，不急不缓，带着一种让人很不舒服的腔调。
江尘侧头看去，只见一个身着华服的修士正站在不远处，背着双手，目光斜斜地瞥过来，上下打量着江尘，嘴角挂着一丝毫不掩饰的轻蔑。
江尘淡淡地看了他一眼，没有说话。
那修士却愈发来劲，指了指九霄阁那座巍峨楼阁，慢条斯理地说道：
“这张请柬，不过是入场的门槛罢了。你以为拿了请柬就能进去坐着？天真。”
他故意顿了顿，确认周围不少修士都竖起了耳朵在听，这才满意地继续往下说：
“九霄阁为了区分贵客，将所有进场修士划分成了四个区域，
普通区，听好了，最低是两百玄晶，但这还只是最底层的，没有座位，只能在外场站着，连内场的门都摸不到。
中等区嘛，一千玄晶，好歹有了个坐席，偶尔碰上些神药灵草，也能举举牌子，不过...”
他拖长了语调，斜眼瞥着江尘，
“遇上真正的至宝，中等区连竞价的资格都没有，上等区，两千玄晶，不光有坐席，还有灵酒仙露供应，除了那些稀世珍品，都可以竞价。”
“不过，这也只是次顶级，至于最顶级的至尊区...”
他环视四周，才缓缓说出那个让人死心的价码：
“一万玄晶才能进入，只有上古大族和圣道宗门才有能力购买，
而且无论是否成功竞拍，入场费用概不退还，所以说呢，九霄阁根本不是你们这些边远小族能来的地方。”
话音落下，全场一片哗然。
“一万玄晶！”

有人忍不住倒吸一口凉气，
“这足够一个宗门传承万年了，竟然只是一张门票钱？”
“我只是来见识见识，连普通区都要两百玄晶，这还让不让人活了？”
“你懂什么，至尊区那是给上古家族和无上道统准备的，咱们这些人，连普通区都嫌贵。”
江尘也忍不住眼角微微一跳。
一万玄晶，
他来到太玄天这么久，全部家当加起来，也不过几千玄晶出头，而在这里，一万玄晶仅仅只是一张门票钱，连根毛都带不回去。
那华服修士显然看出了江尘的捉襟见肘，脸上的笑意愈发浓郁，他缓缓从袖中取出自己的请柬，又拿出一枚储物戒指，从中清点出两千玄晶，整整齐齐地码在接引侍从面前的玉盘上。
“上等区。”
他故意将声音放得不大不小，刚好让周围数十丈内的人都能听见。
两千玄晶，这已经是一个寻常宗门长老级别的人物才能拿得出的手笔了，果不其然，周围顿时投来一片羡慕和敬畏的目光。
“这位道友，出手真是阔绰啊。”
“两千玄晶只为一个坐席，看来定是大宗门出身。”
“人比人气死人，我连普通区的两百玄晶都得凑钱才拿得出来...”
那修士听着周围的议论，挺了挺胸膛，用一种近乎怜悯的目光看了江尘一眼，这才昂首阔步地向九霄阁正门走去。
content_en:
"Are there any levels?"
Jiang Chen said doubtfully,
"You're not from the three states of Middle-earth, are you?"
A voice came from beside him, unhurried and unhurried, with a very uncomfortable tone.
Jiang Chen looked sideways and saw a monk in rich attire standing not far away, with his hands behind his back and his eyes squinting over him. He looked Jiang Chen up and down with a hint of undisguised contempt on his lips.
Jiang Chen glanced at him indifferently and said nothing.
The monk became more and more enthusiastic, pointed to the towering pavilion of Jiuxiao Pavilion, and said slowly:
"This invitation is just the threshold for admission. Do you think you can go in and sit down after taking the invitation? You are naive."
He paused deliberately and made sure that many monks around him had pricked up their ears to listen. Then he continued with satisfaction:
"In order to distinguish the distinguished guests, Jiuxiao Pavilion divided all entering monks into four areas.
In the general area, listen up, the minimum is 200 Xuanjing, but this is only the lowest level, there are no seats, you can only stand in the outfield, and you can't even touch the door to the infield.
In the middle area, Qian Xuanjing finally has a place to sit. Occasionally, he comes across some magic herbs and can hold up signs, but..."
He prolonged his tone and glanced sideways at Jiang Chen,
"When it comes to real treasures, the middle-level area is not even qualified to bid. In the upper-level area, two thousand mysterious crystals not only have seats, but also a supply of spiritual wine and fairy dew. Except for those rare treasures, everyone can bid."
"However, this is only the second-highest level. As for the top-level Supreme Zone..."
He looked around and then slowly said the disappointing price:
"Ten thousand Xuanjing can only enter, and only the ancient clans and the Holy Dao sect can afford to purchase it.
And regardless of whether the bidding is successful or not, the admission fee will not be refunded, so Jiuxiao Pavilion is not a place for remote tribes like you. "
As soon as the words fell, the whole place was in an uproar.
"Ten thousand mysterious crystals!"
Some people couldn't help but take a breath of cold air.
"This is enough for a sect to be passed down for ten thousand years, but it's just a ticket?"
"I'm just here to see the experience. Even the ordinary area requires two hundred Xuanjing. How can this allow people to live?"
"What do you know? The Supreme District is prepared for the ancient families and supreme orthodoxy. For people like us, even the ordinary district is too expensive."
Jiang Chen couldn't help but the corners of his eyes twitched slightly.
Ten thousand mysterious crystals,
He has been in Taixuantian for so long, and all his belongings combined are only a few thousand Xuanjing. But here, 10,000 Xuanjing is just the price of a ticket, and he can't even take a hair back with him.
The monk in the splendid attire obviously noticed Jiang Chen's difficulty, and the smile on his face grew stronger. He slowly took out his invitation card from his sleeve, and took out a storage ring. He counted out two thousand mysterious crystals from it, and placed them neatly on the jade plate in front of the attendant.
"Superior area."
He deliberately kept his voice moderate, just enough so that people within a few dozen feet around him could hear it.
Two thousand mysterious crystals, this was already something that only an ordinary sect elder could produce. As expected, the surrounding people suddenly cast their eyes with envy and awe.
"This fellow Taoist is really generous."
"Two thousand mysterious crystals are just for one seat. It seems that he must be from a big sect."
"The comparison between people is so irritating. I even had to raise money to get the 200 Xuan Crystals from the ordinary area..."
The monk listened to the discussions around him, puffed out his chest, looked at Jiang Chen with an almost pity look, and then walked towards the main entrance of Jiuxiao Pavilion with his head held high.
